paragraphs: My teaching activity covers physics and chemistry, statistical thermodynamics, artificial intelligence, machine learning, deep learning and Python.
It has taken place in secondary education, engineering school and university, with audiences ranging from lower-secondary-school pupils to Master’s-level engineering students.

directContributions.label: King’s College London
directContributions.text: Designed the statistical-thermodynamics programme and teaching materials in full, then taught the course in English to approximately one hundred third-year chemistry students between January and June 2023.

directContributions.label: ECPM — University of Strasbourg
directContributions.text: Taught artificial intelligence, machine learning, deep learning and Python to three cohorts of approximately thirty Master’s-level engineering students between 2021 and 2023.

directContributions.label: Secondary education
directContributions.text: Completed five intermittent contracts or teaching placements in physics and chemistry at lower- and upper-secondary-school level between 2008 and 2013.
